class: Employer emails read and forgotten: every submit check saw rejections, interviews and offers in the same Gmail search and logged past them
fix: New employer_signals.py: deterministic classification (rejection before thanks, offer, interview, assessment, verification, recruiter, reminder, confirmation) plus scan_rows preserving the exact confirmation rule (confirmation patterns moved here as the single home). gmail_shows_confirmation stashes the first non-confirmation signal and logs it; submit_verified records it as an employer_email tracker event. Covered by unit tests; the two browser-touching lines ride CI's existing mail tests.
prevention: Mail meaning lives in one pure, unit-tested module; the browser wrapper only fetches rows.
root_cause: The Gmail check returned only the confirmation row: other employer emails in the same 25 rows were debug-logged at best, so rejections and interview invites never reached the tracker.
symptom: The tracker never showed what employers emailed back; interview invites and rejections hid in run logs.
why_tests_missed: Mail tests covered codes, links and confirmations only; nothing classified the rest of the inbox.
